steps: Checked fog light fitment for XLT
Checked small parts for the repair

lines.reason_short: Halogen fog light is the right one for this XLT.
lines.reason_long: The XLT runs halogen fog lights, so the halogen unit is the only one that fits. It is under $150 and returnable.

lines.reason_short: Bezel often cracks when the fog light is smashed.
lines.reason_long: The bezel holds the fog light and usually gets damaged in the same hit. Check it before refitting.

result.reply: I added the halogen fog light and suggested a bezel in case it's cracked too.
